message.content: The existing BER tests already cover definite, indefinite-length, explicitly tagged, and schemaless CHOICE decoding; the four schema-based cases fail. I’ll make the inheritance fix and add a focused regression confirming it works when the selected component isn’t pre-populated in the schema.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /testbed && apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: pyasn1/codec/ber/decoder.py
@@
-class ChoicePayloadDecoder():
+class ChoicePayloadDecoder(AbstractConstructedPayloadDecoder):
*** End Patch
PATCH
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tests/codec/ber/test_decoder.py
@@
     def testBySpec(self):
         self.s.setComponentByPosition(0, univ.Null(b'\x00'))
         assert decoder.decode(
             bytes((5, 0)), asn1Spec=self.s
         ) == (self.s, b'')
+
+    def testBySpecWithoutPreselectedComponent(self):
+        decoded, rest = decoder.decode(bytes((5, 0)), asn1Spec=self.s)
+        assert decoded.getName() == 'place-holder'
+        assert decoded.getComponent() == univ.Null(b'')
+        assert not rest
*** End Patch
PATCH
python /tmp/reproduce_choice_decoder.py && python -Werror -m unittest tests.codec.ber.test_decoder.ChoiceDecoderTestCase -v"}
